questions.stem: Which feature of a leaf's internal structure helps to maximise gas exchange?

options.text: The waxy cuticle on the upper surface
The air spaces between spongy mesophyll cells
The thick cell walls of the epidermal cells
The tightly packed palisade cells with no air spaces

questions.explanation: The spongy mesophyll layer contains loosely packed cells with large air spaces between them. These air spaces allow gases to diffuse freely throughout the leaf, increasing the surface area for gas exchange between the cells and the air.
